question: According to the Census of India 2011, which state has the highest number of slum population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to the 2011 Census of India**, Maharashtra had the highest number of slum dwellers in the country, followed by Andhra Pradesh
 
• In 2011, **Maharashtra had 11.8 million slum dwellers**, which was 18.1% of the country's total slum population.
 
• In 2011, **Andhra Pradesh had 10.2 million slum dwellers**.
 
• In total,** India had 6.55 crore slum dwellers in 2011.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A census is a procedure of systematically acquiring and recording information about the members of a given population. 
 
• This term is used mostly in connection with national population and housing census.
 
• The decennial Census of India has been conducted 15 times, as of 2011.
 
• First synchronised census in India took place in 1881.
 
• Since 1901, it has been taking place every decade.
